content.short: Munify is a cross-border neobank for MENA with USD accounts, a non-custodial wallet and USDC virtual cards.
content.description: Munify is a stablecoin-powered cross-border neobank, backed by Y Combinator, built to help people and businesses in the Middle East and North Africa, starting with Egyptians abroad, move money globally. It offers multi-currency USD accounts, a non-custodial wallet, USD virtual cards backed by USDC, and fast global transfers, with EUR and GBP accounts and invoicing on the way. Munify uses USDC and stablecoin rails to bridge on-chain liquidity with local banking and payout partners, and has secured in-principle approval for a license from the Dubai Financial Services Authority. It serves remote workers, freelancers and businesses that need dependable global money movement, and raised a 4.5 million dollar seed round.
